# Verification: ensure deleted draft_ids are no longer present among scheduled drafts

page_limit = 20

        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not page:
        break
    # page is list per earlier observation
    if isinstance(page, list):
        if not page:
            break
        all_drafts.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            # likely last page
            if page_index == 0 or len(page) == 0:
                pass
            # but don't rely; we'll still try next page
    else:
        # handle dict just in case
        if isinstance(page, dict):
            page_list = page.get('drafts') or page.get('results') or page.get('items') or page.get('data') or []
            if not page_list:
                break
            all_drafts.extend(page_list)
        else:
            break
    page_index += 1

        break
